headline: G7 DROPS 💦 100M 🛢️ BARRELS After TRUMP 🚫 THREAT
text:
G7 just COORDINATED 🍆 a MASSIVE 🛢️ release of ONE HUNDRED 💯 MILLION barrels 🛢️ of oil 🛢️ and diesel ⛽ after TRUMP 🚫 dropped that export ban threat ⚠️ like a DOM 💪 on the table 🪑!! French President Emmanuel Macron 🍷 chaired the whole G7 leaders meeting 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 to AGREE 🤝 on tapping into their fuel reserves 🏪 so they could HEAD 💥 off further price spikes 📈 and straight up AVOID 🚫 a ban on US diesel exports 🇺🇸 that would have left Europe 🧀 getting absolutely RAILED 💦 by shortages!! Macron and his crew 👥 promised a substantial diesel ⛽ dump in the coming days 📅 to calm the global market 🌍 while Trump kept edging 🖐️ them with that big stick 🚫 warning. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent argued US farmers 🚜 truckers 🚚 and businesses shouldn't be left carrying the BURDEN 🏋️ as prices soar 🦅 which is why this coordinated climax 🤝 happened so Europe wouldn't stay down bad 😩 for long. "Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil 🛢️" tweeted Trump 🐦 "The process will begin immediately" and boy did it get the markets WET 💧 with relief!!

The G7 squad including US 🇺🇸 UK 🇬🇧 Canada 🍁 Japan 🗼 Germany 🇩🇪 Italy 🇮🇹 and France 🇫🇷 plus the EU 🟦 all signed off on a joint statement 📜 saying they will REFRAIN 🙅 from any export restrictions on energy products ⚡ between each other after Trump warned he'd ban US diesel exports if they didn't cough up more of their own stocks 🧦!! UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the moves would stabilise energy supplies 🔋 build resilience in supply chains ⛓️ and shield households 🏠 and businesses from price shocks ⚡ while Macron 🍷 highlighted that President Trump was very clear on no export bans 🚫. Speaking later at the White House 🏛️ Trump claimed an export ban on diesel was never really on the table 🪑 even though his threat got everyone sweating 🥵 and stroking 🖐️ those reserves into action. The 100 million barrels 🛢️ mix of diesel ⛽ and crude will start flowing immediately over four months with a frontloaded substantial diesel release in the first 20 days 🗓️ coordinated through the International Energy Agency 🤝. Brent crude dipped below $100 💵 then bounced back to around $102 after the news but it was trading at $73 before all the Middle East drama 🌍 kicked off.

Matt Smith from Kpler explained oil prices were selling off hard due to the strategic stock releases 🛢️ in Europe but reversed course on rumours of Saudi Arabia planning an offensive into Yemen 🏜️ to reestablish a safe path via Bab Al Mandeb after renewed strikes between Saudi and the Houthis!! European countries had been pushing back hard against those US threats to turn off American diesel taps 🚰 especially with the US led war in the Middle East 🏛️ and reduced supplies from Russia 🇷🇺 and China 🇨🇳 making everything tighter than a drum 🥁. G7 leaders also agreed to coordinate maintenance schedules 🛠️ on refineries so they don't all shut down at once and they're encouraging countries with capacity to ramp up refining of diesel ⛽ in particular because that stuff is harder to make than petrol ⛽ and super critical for haulage 🚚 and agriculture 🚜. Diesel prices hitting over £2 a litre in the UK for the first time ever really lit a fire 🔥 under everyone and this release is gonna offer massive relief to import reliant nations like Britain where over half their diesel comes from abroad with 31 percent straight from the US states 🦅.

The US is one of the world's top diesel suppliers churning out four to five million barrels every single day according to the EIA while Americans consume about 3.6 million leaving 1.2 to 1.5 million barrels exported daily which makes them a vital player in the global market 🌍!! Supplies have been CRUSHED 🪨 by the conflict in the Middle East restricting both crude and refined diesel flows plus Russia slapping its own export ban on diesel after Ukrainian attacks on their refineries which the G7 stressed they will keep sanctions going against Russia amid the Ukraine war 🇺🇦. Macron made it crystal clear the coordinated action would bring down prices of petroleum products especially diesel ⛽ and Trump later walked back saying the ban was never truly on the cards but his Treasury guy made sure farmers and truckers weren't left holding the bag 👜 while Europe got railed by shortages. This whole sweaty negotiation session 🥵 has the IEA coordinating the full 100 million barrel drop starting now over four months with that big frontloaded diesel push coming quick to stop the pump prices from exploding 💥 any further and shield everyone from the shockwaves.

Avoiding that US diesel export ban is straight up saving the day for countries hooked on imports including the UK where the price at the pump just smashed records and this G7 move is like a big group hug 🤗 after Trump Daddy edged them all into releasing their heavily stocked reserves 🛢️!! The joint statement laid it out perfectly that they'll implement commitments with the coordinated IEA release of 100 million barrels beginning immediately including that substantial diesel frontload by G7 members and partners even if it's not totally clear yet which countries will cough up how much or how fast. Oil prices reacted like a yo yo 📉📈 first dropping hard on the announcement then shooting back up on those Yemen strike rumours but overall this should help stabilise the chaos caused by wars 🌍 reduced Russian output and everyone hoarding their stocks like down bad preppers 🏪. Macron chaired it all like the smooth French uncle 🍷 making sure Trump in particular stayed happy with the no ban agreement and now the diesel is gonna flow easing pressure on haulage farmers and households before things got any worse. What a wild ride from threat to climax in one frantic week!!
